name.en: Kneeling Nordic Curl with Hand Push-Back

purpose.zh: 练大腿后侧，学会慢慢控制身体往前倒
purpose.en: Build your hamstrings by slowly controlling a forward fall.

text.zh: 跪姿固定脚跟，身体一条直线慢慢往前倒
text.en: Kneel with heels anchored and fall forward slowly in one line

text.zh: 用大腿后侧控制往下的速度。
text.en: Use the backs of your thighs to control the speed.

text.zh: 倒到底双手撑地，屁股往后坐再推回跪直。
text.en: Catch yourself with your hands, sit your hips back and push back up to kneeling.

commonErrors.en: Bending at the hips too early.

cautions.zh: 大腿后侧有拉扯感或疼时停止，先从小幅度做起
cautions.en: Stop if the backs of your thighs feel strained or sore, and start with a small range.

cautions.zh: 脚跟固定不牢时不要做，膝下垫软垫
cautions.en: Do not start unless your heels are securely anchored, and pad your knees.

changes: 名字和 purpose 去掉「离心」（听不懂）；英文名去掉 Eccentric
cue3 按动画写清回位方式：双手撑地、屁股往后坐、再推回跪直
peak 口令改「双手撑地」，对应动画底部手撑地停住
flags: 动画 8 秒 1 次；回位时屁股往后坐（约 84°弯腰）再起身，是否就是想要的「手撑复位」请确认
